title: RideLink control-frame envelope
description: Normative shape of every control-plane frame. See docs/PROTOCOL.md §2.

v.description: Protocol major version. Wire version 1 is the only value this build accepts; a mismatch is ERROR/version_mismatch, not a decode failure.

type.description: Message type. Unknown values MUST be tolerated at the dispatch layer (ignored, logged, not fatal) — this schema only constrains the envelope shape, not the catalogue of known types.

session_id.description: ULID identifying one connected session. Regenerated on fresh CONNECTING, preserved across RECONNECTING.

sender_id.description: Durable peer_id (16 lowercase hex chars), or the sender's provisional peer_id proposal before pairing completes.

msg_id.description: ULID unique per message, used for ack correlation and duplicate suppression.

seq.description: Per-sender monotonic counter, starts at 1 per session.

sent_at_mono_us.description: Sender's monotonic microseconds. Diagnostics/RTT only — never used for scheduling.

payload.description: Type-specific payload. MUST be an object — {} when empty, never null. Unknown fields inside payload MUST be tolerated by every receiver (forward-compatibility rule, PROTOCOL §2 rule 1).
